doc: The token-agnostic core of Sync. Scripts and skills reference ROLES, never vendor or model names. Pool labels are routing aliases, not proof of billing isolation. A capacity route is eligible only when references/pool-inventory.json has distinct declared local pool IDs, observed non-secret authentication modes, and current source and destination headroom marked available. Exact account and workspace identifiers are intentionally not stored.

claude.surface: Anthropic Claude consumer subscription. Claude documents claude.ai, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop as sharing a usage limit.
claude.meter: Plan-, task-, model-, effort-, and feature-dependent usage. Current official plan documentation describes session and weekly limits, but does not establish a universal Opus-only weekly meter.
claude.note: Changing Claude models can change usage, but it is not a documented pool crossing. Do not infer a particular sub-meter without plan-specific evidence.

codex.surface: OpenAI ChatGPT agentic usage surface. Codex shares an agentic usage and credit pool with ChatGPT Work, ChatGPT for Excel, and Workspace Agents where available.
codex.meter: Plan-, task-, model-, and execution-location-dependent shared agentic usage and credits. Window and credit availability are plan-specific.
codex.note: Codex is not a standalone isolated pool. A route from an Anthropic declaration is eligible only when the privacy-safe local pool IDs differ, both authentication modes are observed, and both headroom values are available.

metered.surface: Separately authenticated, approved API billing account
metered.meter: Provider terms, account configuration, rate limits, credits, and spend controls determine availability and billing. Do not infer a universal cap, price, or discount.
metered.note: This may be a distinct pool only after its non-secret declaration, current terms, spend approval, and headroom are observed. It may then relieve a named source pool, but never unconditionally.

spec.purpose: Turn an ambiguous request into an unambiguous brief. The highest-leverage spend in the system.
spec.rationale: Use Claude Code's documented best alias for ambiguous specification. The alias tracks the most capable available model, currently equivalent to opus. This is vendor guidance, not a repository benchmark or an assertion of a separate meter.
spec.verify_note: The alias is documented in the official Claude Code model configuration reference retrieved 2026-08-10. No live Claude call was made during this hardening pass.

orchestrate.purpose: Hold requirements, integrate results, own synthesis. Never delegated.
orchestrate.rationale: Keep the synthesis owner on Claude Code's documented best alias while bounded independent execution uses lower lanes. This follows the operator's quality preference; it is not a measured performance claim.
orchestrate.verify_note: The alias is documented in the official Claude Code model configuration reference retrieved 2026-08-10. No live Claude call was made during this hardening pass.

implement.purpose: Execute a well-specified change. This is a candidate cross-pool route only when the inventory marks it eligible.
implement.rationale: Specified execution is a candidate for a declared distinct OpenAI pool when it has headroom. Without distinct inventory identities, this is a model and harness preference only.

bulk.purpose: Mechanical grind: test triage, lint passes, log reading, file location, renames, docstrings.
bulk.rationale: Use the designated high-volume lane only for precisely specified work with a real check. It is capacity relief only under the declared-pool condition.
bulk.verify_note: Called live 2026-08-09 via `codex exec -m gpt-5.6-luna`: exit 0, model echoed as requested, no substitution. Canon 009 requires calling a model before wiring it, because a provider listing can include ids that fail on invocation.

review.purpose: Adversarial verification of a diff by a reader that did not write it.
review.rationale: Fresh context and non-authorship are the review controls. Reserve higher-reasoning escalation for named triggers, not an assumed model-specific meter.

stuck.purpose: Reached only after the escalation triggers fire. Never a default.
stuck.rationale: Use the documented best alias only after a named trigger. Escalation is an observation, not an argument under sunk cost.
stuck.verify_note: The alias is documented in the official Claude Code model configuration reference retrieved 2026-08-10. No live Claude call was made during this hardening pass.

escalation_triggers.test: task requires root-causing across components rather than localizing
expected horizon beyond roughly one hour of skilled human work
requirements cannot be pinned down before starting
concurrency, memory model, or subtle shared state involved

council_defaults.rationale: canon 006: shared context is what makes delegation cost more. The filesystem is the message bus. canon 007: three focused members beat five scattered ones.

autonomous: reading any file in the workspace
choosing a role, model, effort, and pool
creating and writing run directories and the outcome ledger
requires_human_approval: spending money or changing a spend cap
anything irreversible without a stated rollback path
autonomy_envelope.rationale: canon 012: capability is not authorization. Sync is autonomous inside the workspace and gated at its boundary. This is the line that keeps a council's work owned by a human.
